notes: This contract records the standard API behavior exercised by promoted portable C++ TCK scenarios for timestamped inherited interaction-class delivery. The test uses only the official C++ RTIambassador and FederateAmbassador APIs plus the standard library. The adapter supplies the provider package, selected rich FOM, endpoint, logical-time implementation, and callback configuration; this TCK package defines the fixture class and parameter names. For one timestamped interaction sent on a derived class, a time-constrained base subscriber receives the closest subscribed base class and only its available inherited parameter, while a derived subscriber receives the derived class and both inherited and derived parameters. Both callbacks preserve the timestamp, timestamp order, tag, producer, transportation, and retraction designator, and neither recipient receives the interaction before requesting an advance. Both callback models passed against the installed package. Normative traceability is supplied by the IEEE 1516.1-2025 timestamped interaction, received-class/parameter, order-type, and time-advance requirement contracts and the IEEE 1516.2-2025 interaction hierarchy contract referenced by the scenario catalog. This artifact is an API/requirement trace, not certification or a conformance claim.
